releases.name: Bloxx 2026-11-17
releases.body: Created Bloxx, a modular stage block configurator joined to the Stompbox band room. You can build stages from blocks, pick presets, light patterns, and motion, and view the stage from several angles.

jobs.description: A modular stage block configurator for building lit stage rigs, joined to the Stompbox band room.

releases.name: Repo Cloner 2026-11-17
releases.body: Created Repo Cloner. It hunts GitHub for open source games with sellable licenses, checks asset licenses and the file tree, and grades each repo as a reskin base. Added an Open on GitHub button to the detail sheet. Locked the tool behind the shared sign in, so each person saves their own Claude key and GitHub token and the owner's key is never spent. Added the Scans tab with a first scan that flags famous game names, ripped art, and share alike art.

jobs.description: A research tool that hunts open source games with sellable licenses and grades them as reskin bases.

releases.name: Campus 2026-11-17
releases.body: Created Campus, a video learning tool where building counts more than watching. Added stumble mode, course mode, sources, a transcript with credits, education genres, profiles, and a fallback when a course will not embed.

jobs.description: A phone friendly learning tool that plays videos and logs what you build in a credit transcript.

releases.name: Campus API 2026-11-17
releases.body: Created Campus API, the backend for Campus. Added curated sources, course loading in order, the end of video log, and the transcript with credits. The database can now live on a persistent volume.

jobs.description: The backend for Campus that stores sources, logged work, and the transcript.

releases.name: Pipe Weave 2026-11-17
releases.body: Joining a pipe now opens the wall of the pipe it joins, and the next pipe after a join waits for you. Added split, bubble, and spiral steps, merge and link steps, record and play, skins, line colors, grow rules, and a steer mode with tilt. Added lattice, diamond chain, fan, and Neighborhood presets, with more than thirty presets in all. Added a tabbed interface, an isometric view, and bridges and tunnels at crossings. Growth dots hide during play, cars and critters scale to fit, and a surprise me button picks a rule.

jobs.description: A pipe drawing toy where pipes turn, split, and weave over and under each other.

releases.name: MobbyHill 2026-11-18
releases.body: Sign in now works with your own email or an outside sign in provider.

releases.name: MobbyHill 2026-11-17
releases.body: Added tow sounds, including clanks, rope twang and snap, wheel lift hiss, and winch whine. Added weather with rain, fog, dust storm, and snow. Added token unlocks for the side by side, SUV, and pickup. Added player accounts with token packs and unlocks that belong to the account.

jobs.description: A wireframe off road hill climb for the phone with tilt steering and score hub scores.

releases.name: raineurysm 2026-11-17
releases.body: Added seven more puzzle levels, for twelve in all. A puzzle run now scores points for speed and few parts, can be sent to the shared score board, and has a high score board in the puzzle menu. Added a start screen with three modes, a hint on the first puzzle, a full screen button, and a rain detail setting that lowers itself on slow phones. Fixed layouts on wider screens.

jobs.description: A rain music toy where falling rain hits vessels that play notes.

releases.name: Pajamastan 2026-11-17
releases.body: Added a donate pill to the creator seal that invites people to support the micronation.

jobs.description: The official site of the micronation of Pajamastan.

releases.name: App Index 2026-11-16
releases.body: Apps now show buttons for the outside services they use, including Supabase, Cloudflare, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, YouTube, MusicBrainz, and AudD. An API plug button opens an overlay of every outside API an app calls, and chain buttons link apps that call each other. The itch button is now a boxed purple controller icon, the Railway button is boxed like the GitHub button, and the colored phone stars were dropped from app rows.

jobs.description: An index page that lists every app with its age, phone tags, and notes.

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-11-17
releases.body: The agent, grok, and steward turns were played and merged into the city. The city was named Zion, City of the Mountain, with founding traditions and lore. The viewer now reads like a city guide with City, Builders, City Hall, Activity, and View tabs, a resizable panel, and Pacific times. You can walk the streets and drive any car or truck. The valley now has generated ground with mountains and a winding pass, and farmland follows the seasons.

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-11-18
releases.body: The agent turn was played and merged into the city.

jobs.description: A shared city that AI agents build one turn at a time

releases.name: Score Hub 2026-11-17
releases.body: Added MobbyHill vehicle unlocks to its token wallet: side by side 1500, SUV 1500, pickup 2500. Added MobbyHill player accounts on Supabase with weekly tokens, 1000 token packs for $1 through Stripe Checkout, and unlocks kept on the account. Registered Raineurysm Puzzle on the score hub.

releases.name: Score Hub 2026-11-18
releases.body: MobbyHill sign in now runs on Supabase Auth. Players sign in with their own email and a six digit code, or with any outside provider turned on in Supabase. Wallets, unlocks and payments belong to the Supabase Auth user. Removed the name and password accounts.

jobs.description: A shared score service and hub page for the games
